data.define: Used to react when something is awkward, embarrassing or a bad idea.

misuse.text: Don't tell your host 'big yikes' about dinner.

publish.title: What does "big yikes" mean?
publish.value: Big yikes = That's really awkward or bad. Example: "Socks with sandals? Big yikes." (very casual English, US).
